svg.text: Two libraries behind one function list
which Java class each Spark math function calls, and whether HotSpot
replaces it on the Ryzen AI 9 HX PRO 370 laptop (x86, JDK 25)
fdlibm in Java, on every host
red: answers that can change with the host. Spark chose StrictMath for exp, ln and pow,
so their Math stubs, which differ too, never reach a query.
